lines.text: @sai_front pedals across a busy bridge at rush hour, weaving past stopped cars, smiling under his helmet.

new_beats.text: A driver in a stalled car glances over and watches him glide past.

writes.note: I added a beat at 3 s: a stuck driver watches him glide by. The rest is unchanged.

reply.rationale: The shot had no reaction from the traffic. A stuck driver watching him pass adds contrast and keeps to the existing action and refs.
